text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of on-street accessible parking space for persons with disabilities on the south side of Northview Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the south side of Northview Avenue, between a point 73 metres east of Victoria Park Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further east.
